_readme: F&O-eligibility exceptions for symbols/equity.json's 202 curated equities. equity.json is the general NSE board list (all stocks), NOT the smaller NSE F&O-eligible list -- generating a futures contract for every equity in equity.json produces invalid symbols for stocks that have no listed derivatives at all. This file is a live-verified EXCLUSION list, not a full eligibility table.

coverage.method: Each symbol below was individually checked live in the Fyers mobile app on 2026-08-01: searched by name, confirmed whether Fut/Option results appeared in search, and confirmed whether the stock's Overview page shows an 'Option Chain' button.
coverage.warning: IMPORTANT -- do NOT treat 'not listed below' as verified-eligible. Only these 9 have been checked. The remaining ~193 equities are UNVERIFIED, not confirmed-eligible -- current behavior (generate futures for them) is unchanged/unproven for those, same as before this file existed. Expand 'excluded' only from live-confirmed evidence (real search results, real absence of an Option Chain button) -- never guessed or inferred from a stock's size/sector/index membership.

confirmedEligibleButPartiallyListed.note: CONFIRMED real F&O (real futures price + real option chain with live strikes, verified live in Fyers app). NOT excluded here -- this is a listing-lead-time issue, not an eligibility issue: only the Aug26 contract was listed at verification time, Sep/Oct26 were not yet listed and correctly failed as invalid symbols. Same class of issue as MCX SILVERM/SILVERMIC's restricted month cycle, just with an unknown listing lead time for this stock rather than a known cycle -- do not guess a fix here, this needs to be handled the same way an unlisted month is handled elsewhere: attempt and let a genuine 'invalid symbol' response be the signal, not pre-filtered.
